name: – After recital G – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text: G. whereas the Commission’s evaluation of the CFP concludes that discarding fish remains a structural feature of many fisheries, especially mixed fisheries; whereas a substantial proportion of discarded fish die after release; whereas undocumented discards are not deducted from quota and contribute to overfishing and decline of fish populations;
